purpose: Research-only demand/fare/ops source packet for Grok financial model building. This file admits only source-backed inputs and keeps unverified demand/fare cells null.

owner_split.tasklet: public-source research, exact source qualification, route/fare/demand/ops input sidecars, proposal narrative rationale

source_rows.candidate_corridor: Mumbai / Bhaucha Dhakka / Ferry Wharf ↔ Mandwa / Mandwa Ro-Pax Jetty / Alibaug
usable_facts: Route selector supports Mumbai to Mandwa.
M2M describes the service as Maharashtra's first Ro-Pax ferry, operational year-round including monsoons.
Official page states passenger fare from ₹400 onwards, motorcycle from ₹210 onwards, 4-wheelers from ₹1,020 onwards, bicycles from ₹110 onwards, buses from ₹4,500 onwards.
Official page lists Mumbai terminal at Ferry Wharf / Bhaucha Dhakka, Mumbai Port and Mandwa terminal at Mandwa Ropax Service Jetty.
Official page states the vehicle deck can accommodate over 120 cars, two-wheelers and buses.

fare_floor_inr.basis: official onwards fare, not average fare

ops_anchor.vehicle_deck_capacity_fact: over 120 cars/two-wheelers/buses, exact mix not specified

source_rows.grok_instruction: Use as a fare/ops anchor only. Do not invent passenger volumes; if model requires demand, leave demand null or use a clearly labelled template assumption outside Tasklet's sourced facts.

source_rows.candidate_corridor: Government of Goa River Navigation Department ferry-route network; Mormugao/Goa display-market support only where exact sealed IDs bind
source_rows.source_name: River Navigation Department, Government of Goa — ferry routes and Citizens' Charter
usable_facts: Official RND page exists for ferry routes; scrape exposes heading only, while the official Citizens' Charter exposes detailed route/toll/ops content.
Citizens' Charter states the department operates regular ferry services on 21 routes in Goa, including one inter-state route (Aronda–Kiranpani).
Citizens' Charter states regular service is about 18–20 hours per day, with ferry available on request for the remaining period.

Citizens' Charter states foot passengers are exempt from ferry toll from 1-Apr-2000 and two-wheelers from 1-Jan-2006; later toll table text also says foot passengers, two-wheelers and three-wheelers are exempt.

Citizens' Charter provides vehicle/cargo toll bands by route group: cars/jeeps/light vehicles ₹7/₹10/₹14/₹27 depending route group, light commercial ₹15/₹20/₹20/₹43, medium/heavy bands where allowed, and special trip charges ₹55 or ₹255.
Citizens' Charter lists 21 ferry routes, deployed ferries, operating hours, and a named ferry vessel roster including F/B Mormugao.

fare_floor_inr.vehicle_toll_bands: official charter includes vehicle/cargo toll bands; do not treat as premium passenger fare

source_rows.grok_instruction: Use for Goa route/ops context and public-ferry baseline only. Do not use vehicle tolls as Navier passenger fare without an explicit model choice by Grok.
